bio.text: Janet Petersen is a Democratic state senator for Iowa Senate District 18 and has served in the Iowa Senate since 2013, after serving six terms in the Iowa House.

The Iowa Legislature's 2023 biography lists Petersen as a communications and marketing consultant and co-founder of Healthy Birth Day, Inc., with degrees from the University of Northern Iowa and Drake University, born in 1970 in Des Moines.
The Iowa Senate Democrats' biography page says Petersen was the first woman elected Iowa Senate Democratic Leader, serving 2017-2020.
